channel.title: Zrzur API changelog
channel.description: Changes to the Zrzur Bot API and its documentation.

item.title: Documentation, 2026-11-09
item.description:
No change to the API. These pages now say what a bot author had to find out by trying:
- The docs open at once, without signing in and without waiting for a connection. - Event reference: the channel types, and how to tell a direct message from a server message. - Gateway: what to do when a privileged intent is off, and when a switch counts. - Without a library: the Node example sends intents: 33, like the text and the Python example. - Channels and webhooks: plain HTTP comes first, the body of POST /servers/{server}/channels with private and category, and the rules of a thread's first message. - Slash commands: where an Attachment option's file arrives, and why its id cannot be sent again. - Messages: channel links <#id>, the answer of GET /channels/{target}/messages and its order. - Overview: a sample GET / answer. - Errors: which answer means "the bot is not in that server". - The reference names only the bot SDK, and its status badge agrees with the check below it.

The first Zrzur release. Everything in these pages describes it.
- Interactions: slash commands with options, choices, sub-commands, localised names and autocomplete; user and message menu commands; buttons, selects and forms; private, deferred and follow-up answers. Buttons and forms also work in a direct message with the bot. - Interactions over HTTP, signed requests to your own address. - Gateway intents decide what a connection receives. MESSAGE_CONTENT, SERVER_MEMBERS and PRESENCE are privileged and switched on in the Developer Portal. GET /gateway/schema describes every event. - Threads and forums: POST and GET /channels/{target}/threads, PATCH /channels/{target}/thread, with the permissions CreateThreads, CreateForumPosts and SendMessageInThreads. - Over REST: POST /channels/{target}/typing, and pinned messages through POST /channels/{target}/search with pinned: true. - Webhooks: tokens are shown once, start with zrzur_wh_ and can be replaced. - Rate limits: a 429 body has retry_after in milliseconds and global. Every error has a stable type. - OAuth2 with PKCE.
